claim: DIVERGENCIA DAS DUAS VISOES DE STDLIST/PLANO NO LIMITE DO DIA (lab HWA 10.2.8, read-only). ARTEFATOS DISTINTOS: o MDM (tws-hwa) mantem stdlist proprio em /opt/hwa/TWSDATA/stdlist/ (relogio BR) e o BMDM (tws-bmdm) em /opt/hwa/TWS/TWSDATA/stdlist/ (relogio UTC) — mesmo dia de producao, conteudos diferentes, sem bind mount compartilhado. (a) RECONCILIACAO: 'sc @' das duas pontas CONCORDA (MDM = UNIX MASTER, MDM_BK = UNIX FTA; o '*' e o no local de cada visao; as flags divergem apenas pela convencao do no local — o MDM ve MDM_BK='LTI JW MDEA' e o BMDM ve MDM='LTI JW M A'). 'planman showinfo' das duas CONCORDA no mesmo instante: MDM 'Plan last update 09/12/2026 23:59 BR' == BMDM '09/13/2026 02:59 GMT'; MDM 'Production plan end 09/25/2026 21:04 BR' == BMDM '09/26/2026 00:04 GMT'; Run number 69 / Confirm 69 nas duas. Link MDM<->MDM_BK: o merge do MDM mostra 'MY:LINK ... MDM_BK State is being changed: LINKED=TCP' + 'MY:JOBMAN-UP for MDM_BK' as 17:19:16 BR (e MY:AGENT-UP para MDM_BKA as 17:19:32 BR), SEM nenhum MY:UNLINK de MDM_BK depois (os UNLINK sao de MDM_BKA e de AGT1). (b) AS VISOES DIVERGEM NO BOUNDARY: contagem por dia (boundary do dia D em (D-1) 21:00 BR no MDM = D 00:00 UTC no BMDM): MDM -> 09/12: 13 READY / 0 launch; 09/13: 13 READY / 0 launch; 09/14: 0 LINHAS (burst AUSENTE). BMDM -> 09/12: 13 READY / 2 launch; 09/13: 13 READY / 2 launch; 09/14: 20 READY / 0 launch. Ou seja: o burst de 09/14 existe SOMENTE no BMDM; o MDM nao registrou passagem nenhuma. O stdlist do BMDM virou para 20260914 as 00:08:33Z (AWSDDW100I SWITCHED); o do MDM NAO virou (ainda escreve 20260913 as 21:28 BR = 00:28Z). A ultima atividade de plano no merge do MDM e apenas 'MY:UNLINK AGT1' a cada ~10 min (21:08:32 / 21:18:32 / 21:28:32 BR), alem de 'AWSBCV082I Writing socket: (errno=111)' + 'AWSBCV035W Mailman was unable to link to workstation: AGT1' as 21:28:32 BR. CONCLUSAO: '20 readied / 0 launch' e uma propriedade da VISAO DO BACKUP (bmdm), NAO (ainda) do dominio; o master (MDM) nao registrou burst. HIPOTESE (NAO PROVADA): a anomalia pode nao ser do launcher, e sim consequencia de DIVERGENCIA DE PLANO no boundary — o pass do limite rodou na visao do backup e nao na do master; se confirmar, o achado real e a divergencia e o '20 readied / 0 launch' deixa de significar 'o dominio readiou e nao lancou'. Nao ha split-brain de master (sc @ concorda; o engine do MDM esta vivo: netman/batchman/jobman/mailman + Liberty 31115/31116 LISTEN; o batchman do MDM foi reiniciado as 20:19Z).
